result.instructions: Tools for Hostaway, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Hostaway data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run hostaway_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hostaway_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hostaway_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. hostaway_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hostaway_list_listings
tools.title: List listings
tools.description: List the account's properties (listings) with name, address, capacity, base price, fees and check-in times. Filter by name, city, country, property type, availability for a date range and guest count, or active/archived status. Hostaway: GET /v1/listings.

availabilityGuestNumber.description: Only listings that fit this many guests.

specialStatus.description: Filter by status; omit for both active and archived.

offset.description: Records to skip from the start.

tools.name: hostaway_get_listing
tools.title: Get one listing
tools.description: Fetch a single listing by id — full details including description, house rules, amenities, images, fees, taxes, cancellation policy and access info (door code, wifi). Hostaway: GET /v1/listings/{listingId}.

tools.name: hostaway_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations
tools.description: List reservations across all channels (Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, direct…) with guest, dates, status, price and channel. Filter by listing, channel, arrival/departure window, guest name or email, unread messages, and more. Default order is newest first; for large accounts page with afterId (the id of the last reservation on the previous page). Channel ids: 2000 direct, 2018 airbnbOfficial, 2002 homeaway/Vrbo, 2005 bookingcom, 2007 expedia, 2013 bookingengine, 2019 marriott, 2020 partner, 2022 google. Hostaway: GET /v1/reservations.

assigneeUserId.description: Only reservations assigned to this user.

dateType.description: Which date startDate/endDate bound (only on accounts with the new reservations query; 'cancellation' also restricts to cancelled).

hasUnreadConversationMessages.description: Only reservations with unread guest messages.

includeCancellationPolicy.description: Attach the cancellation-policy snapshot to each reservation.

offset.description: Records to skip from the start.

afterId.description: Cursor: the id of the last reservation from the previous page (offset is then ignored).

tools.name: hostaway_get_reservation
tools.title: Get one reservation
tools.description: Fetch a single reservation by its Hostaway id — guest contact details, dates, guest counts, price breakdown, payment state, door code, notes, channel and cancellation policy. Hostaway: GET /v1/reservations/{reservationId}.

tools.name: hostaway_get_reservation_logs
tools.title: Get reservation change history
tools.description: The audit trail for one reservation: every field change with previous and new value, when, and by which user (most recent first). Useful for 'who changed these dates / this price?'. Hostaway: GET /v1/reservations/{reservationId}/logs.

offset.description: Records to skip from the start.

tools.name: hostaway_get_calendar
tools.title: Get listing calendar
tools.description: Day-by-day availability and pricing for one listing over a date range: status (available, blocked, reserved, pending), nightly price, min/max stay, closed-to-arrival/departure and notes. Set includeResources to see the reservations occupying each day. Hostaway: GET /v1/listings/{listingId}/calendar.

tools.name: hostaway_calculate_price
tools.title: Quote a stay
tools.description: Calculate what a stay at a listing would cost — total price plus the component breakdown (base rate, cleaning fee, taxes, discounts). A calculation only: nothing is booked or held. Hostaway: POST /v1/listings/{listingId}/calendar/priceDetails (version 2).

markup.description: Price markup multiplier (must be more than 1.0).

tools.name: hostaway_list_conversations
tools.title: List guest conversations
tools.description: List guest conversations (the unified inbox across channels), each with its latest message and linked reservation. Filter to one reservation. Hostaway: GET /v1/conversations.

offset.description: Records to skip from the start.

tools.name: hostaway_list_conversation_messages
tools.title: Read a conversation
tools.description: The messages in one guest conversation — body, direction (isIncoming), channel/email/SMS type, send status and timestamps. By default only sent messages; set includeScheduledMessages to also see scheduled, paused or failed ones. Hostaway: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.

includeScheduledMessages.description: Also return scheduled / failed / paused messages.

offset.description: Records to skip from the start.

tools.name: hostaway_list_reviews
tools.title: List reviews
tools.description: List guest-to-host and host-to-guest reviews with rating (0-10), public review, private feedback and the host's reply. Filter by listings, reservation, type, status, rating range, dates, guest name, or whether the host has replied. Hostaway: GET /v1/reviews.

listingMapIds.description: Only reviews for these listing ids.

hasHostReply.description: true = only replied-to reviews; false = only unanswered.

offset.description: Records to skip from the start.

tools.name: hostaway_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List operational tasks (cleaning, maintenance, check-in/out) with assignee, status, time window and cost. Filter by reservation, status, text match, channel, or start/deadline windows. Hostaway: GET /v1/tasks.

offset.description: Records to skip from the start.

tools.name: hostaway_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses and extras
tools.description: List expenses (negative amounts) and extras (positive amounts) recorded against listings and reservations, with date, concept, categories and the owner statements they appear on. Hostaway: GET /v1/expenses.

offset.description: Records to skip from the start.

tools.name: hostaway_list_owner_statements
tools.title: List owner statements
tools.description: List the account's owner statements (id and name). Hostaway: GET /v1/ownerStatements.

tools.name: hostaway_get_owner_statement
tools.title: Get one owner statement
tools.description: Fetch one owner statement — the filter it was generated with (listings, date range), summary and per-reservation financial data, grand totals, expenses, and owner / property-manager details. Hostaway: GET /v1/ownerStatement/{ownerStatementId}.

tools.name: hostaway_create_reservation
tools.title: Create a reservation
tools.description: Create a new reservation on a listing (it blocks the calendar and syncs to connected channels). Only channelId 2000 (direct, the default), 2002 (homeaway) or 2020 (partner) are accepted. To price it correctly, call hostaway_calculate_price first and pass its total as totalPrice. Overbooking protection is always left on. Hostaway: POST /v1/reservations.

hostNote.description: Internal host note (not shown to the guest).

doorCode.description: Door / lock code for this stay.

tools.name: hostaway_update_reservation
tools.title: Update a reservation
tools.description: Change fields on an existing reservation — guest details and counts, dates, check-in/out hours, door code, host note or comment. Send only the fields to change. The listing cannot be changed, and this tool never cancels or reprices a booking. Date changes on channel bookings may be overwritten by the channel. Hostaway: PUT /v1/reservations/{reservationId}.

hostNote.description: Internal host note (not shown to the guest).

doorCode.description: Door / lock code for this stay.

tools.name: hostaway_update_calendar
tools.title: Update listing calendar
tools.description: Change availability and/or pricing for a date range on one listing, pushed to every connected channel: block (isAvailable=false) or open days, set the nightly price, min/max stay, closed-to-arrival/departure, or a note. For multi-unit listings set desiredUnitsToSell instead of isAvailable (0 blocks). Hostaway: PUT /v1/listings/{listingId}/calendar.

isAvailable.description: false blocks the days, true opens them (single-unit listings).

desiredUnitsToSell.description: Multi-unit listings: units to sell (0 blocks).

tools.name: hostaway_send_message
tools.title: Send a guest message
tools.description: Send a message to the guest in a conversation — it is delivered immediately and cannot be recalled. Delivered by email by default, or via the booking channel, SMS or WhatsApp. Attachments are not supported. Rate-limited by Hostaway to 30 messages per minute. Hostaway: POST /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.

tools.name: hostaway_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create an operational task — e.g. a cleaning after a checkout or a maintenance job — optionally tied to a listing and reservation, assigned to a user, with a time window, category and cost. Hostaway: POST /v1/tasks.

listingMapId.description: Listing id the task belongs to.

reservationId.description: Reservation id the task relates to.

assigneeUserId.description: User id to assign the task to.

status.description: pending, confirmed, inProgress, completed or cancelled.

categoriesMap.description: Categories: 1 cleaning, 2 maintenance, 3 check-in, 4 check-out, 5 back office, 6 other.

tools.name: hostaway_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Update a task — change its status (e.g. completed), reassign it, move its window, or add a resolution note. Send only the fields to change. Hostaway: PUT /v1/tasks/{taskId}.

listingMapId.description: Listing id the task belongs to.

reservationId.description: Reservation id the task relates to.

assigneeUserId.description: User id to assign the task to.

status.description: pending, confirmed, inProgress, completed or cancelled.

categoriesMap.description: Categories: 1 cleaning, 2 maintenance, 3 check-in, 4 check-out, 5 back office, 6 other.
